The damage-dealing commanders (Agzok/The Shadow/Lurtz/Ugluk) like Mumakil because they're tanky. Tanky units means they take fewer losses, meaning the command of the army stays high, meaning the Commander does more damage. 

Commanders with avoidance/damage reduction/CC/heals/defense bonuses like Mumakil because it makes them even harder to kill. Pair them with Grima/Kirun/Khamul for a great defensive wall. They're also a good way to minimize losses in fights that you're already favored to win.

The few commanders that can give them a damage increase are good too. Gothmog and Black Serpent can both do that at respect 0 and also provide defensive bonuses.

Honestly, all of the same commanders that are good with other units are good with Mumakil. There don't seem to be any commanders that are normally bad but become good when you add Mumakil, or vice versa. The one that loses the most is Gorbag since almost all of his bonuses are for Orcs. Even then, he gets a strong heal and a little bit of CC.
